summary: Iteration 2 - multi-page redesign. Backend 6/6 pytest passed (POST/GET /api/inquiries, validation 422, minimal payload, order newest-first, no _id leak). Frontend all requested flows verified: 5 routes load directly by URL and via Navbar with data-testid page-home/events/services/about/contact; nav-quote-btn, hero-quote-btn -> /contact; hero-events-btn -> /events; scroll-to-top on route change (1049 -> 0); navbar position=fixed; contact form empty submit shows error toast and does NOT submit (contact-success not rendered); valid submit renders contact-success and toast; images render on all pages (0 broken across /, /events, /services, /about, /contact).

minor.issue: Returns 200 instead of semantic 201 Created (unchanged from iteration_1).

action_items: (Optional / dev-only) Hydration warning on /contact: dev tooling injects <span data-ve-dynamic> children inside <option> for EVENTS map (source: Contact.jsx line 105). Not an app bug — comes from x-source-* instrumentation. If it becomes noisy, disable that instrumentation for <option> children or move the option label into a plain string.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout scroll-to-top uses behavior:'instant' correctly on pathname change; good.
Navbar is position:fixed and stays across routes; verified computed style.

Contact.jsx: client-side validation only checks name/email/message truthiness — server enforces EmailStr for real email validation which is fine; consider also showing inline field errors for better UX.
No rate limiting on public POST /api/inquiries; spam risk in prod.
InquiryCreate has no max_length on name/message — abuse vector on public endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ prefixed inquiries added this iteration (test_ui@example.com plus reused test_min/test_john from iteration_1). Safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-page routing (React Router v6, /, /events, /services, /about, /contact) verified. Testids: page-home, page-events, page-services, page-about, page-contact, nav-home/events/services/about, nav-quote-btn, hero-quote-btn, hero-events-btn, navbar, contact-form, input-name/email/phone/travelers, select-event, input-message, contact-submit-btn, contact-success, contact-reset-btn. Backend unchanged from iteration_1.
